nguon: 💬 Giao tiếp · Bản thân & gia đình · bài tự soạn
kind: 10 câu hỏi – đáp về bản thân và gia đình
L: So, where are you from originally?
Hue, but I've lived in Hanoi since I was ten.
He's retired. He used to drive a bus.
Do you live with your parents?
Yeah, for now. I'm saving up to move out.
She just turned three last week.
Are you close to your grandparents?
Very. I see them every Sunday.
Pretty quiet. We lived in a small village.
Who's the funniest person in your family?
My uncle, hands down. He never stops joking.
Do you ever argue with your brother?
All the time, but we always make up.
What are you like as a person?
I'm shy at first, but I open up quickly.
Would you like more kids someday?
Maybe. I haven't made up my mind yet.
